The user is swinging the remaining open right-hand door toward the cabinet face.
Both overhead cabinet doors are flush and closed.

The user pulls the center edge of the left-hand door outward.

The left-hand door remains projected open beside the cabinet.
The user appears to begin bringing the left-hand leaf inward.
The left leaf appears closed while the other leaf is being swung shut.
The entire overhead cabinet is closed.

The user pulls the drawer outward by its handle.
The food-filled drawer is fully open.
The drawer remains fully open.

events.object_description: Top utensil and cutting-board drawer to the right of the stove

notes: Open is treated as on and closed as off. Four distinct movable parts are counted, including the two independently manipulated leaves of the overhead cabinet. The precise closing order of those leaves is mildly uncertain because of close viewpoints and partial occlusion.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens separate top drawers on either side of the stove, and later closes all four movable parts.
